configurations.name: web
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && EXPO_PUBLIC_LELAP_PROXY=${EXPO_PUBLIC_LELAP_PROXY:-http://localhost:8788} pnpm --filter @lelap/app exec expo start --web --port 8082

configurations.name: proxy
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && pnpm --filter @lelap/proxy exec wrangler dev --port 8788
